name: murphy
description: Murphy RAG system, one repository: backend, frontend and the shared contract are npm workspaces; data/ is a Python project beside them. The scripts below wrap the Docker Compose stack.

scripts.check: npm run build -w @murphy/contract && npm run type-check -w backend && npm run lint -w backend && npm test -w backend && npm run type-check -w frontend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm test -w frontend && npm run format:check -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend
